essence: Secret final sacrament of the Śāmbhava teaching announced.
Funerary initiation after śaktipāta for all stations up to gurus.
Upper-teaching samaya-struck selves repaired by the knowing guru.
Negligent stumblers covered by Dīkṣottara ordinance.
Corpse-uplifting image-rite transferred whole onto the corpse-body.
Siddhātantra rule in reverse: last first, first last.
Twofold withdrawal of oblations; worship-bathed sādhaka eased.
Freedom or sky-roving; ripe teacher place-freed; Goddess addressed.
Pure-minded exempt; mantra-slain hell-bound (reported view).
Ultra-compassionate rescue; maṇḍala shed in the śmaśāna rite.
Strict school: full nyāsa after Vibhu-worship in the mortuary.
Foot-to-head dissolution awakening through rite-knowledge-absorption.
Bindu blocks, śakti-seed pierces, nāda rubbed, trident strikes.
Suṣumnā-emission beats the kalās; the bound soul trembles.
Left hand raised, soul joined to Supreme; signs for the faithless.
Signs build trust, never cause release (Kulagahvara fence).
Unseen inferred through proofs; puryaṣṭaka-class offered (Dīkṣottara).
Ear-petal lotus: Sadāśiva center, four-god tetrad from east.
Senses, bodies, intellect, ego, mind offered to Brahmās in order.
Libation plus hundredfold fire: renunciate cleansing of the eightfold city.
City gone: no heavens; no worldly rites after.
Mādhavakula: no piṇḍa, water, tears even for the dead.
Memorial Śiva-and-wheel worship by capacity.
Lord-spoken funerary sacrifice told.

rasa.dominant: karuṇa with adbhuta weight (mortality met by proof; wonder at signs)
rasa.sthayibhava: śoka (grief) turned toward mokṣa through visible proof
rasa.justification: The ahnika grieves — corpse, hell, tears renounced — and each grief is worked: burned, beaten, joined, inferred; wonder at the trembling body and the rising hand converts mourning into method.

sections.SUMMARY: The secret final sacrament of the Śāmbhava teaching. Funerary initiation after śaktipāta for all from lower stations to gurus; for upper-teaching samaya-struck selves by the knowing guru; for negligent stumblers per Dīkṣottara. The corpse-uplifting image-rite transfers whole onto the corpse-body; the Siddhātantra rule runs last-first. Withdrawn oblation by oblation, the rite is twofold — eased for the worship-bathed sādhaka. From body's fall comes freedom or sky-roving; for the ripe teacher anywhere, no rite binds place; for the pure-minded none at all — though the mantra-slain lie in hell and need the ultra-compassionate guru, maṇḍala shed at the burning ground while the strict keep full nyāsa after Vibhu-worship. Foot-to-head dissolution awakening through rite-knowledge-absorption; bindu blocks, śakti-seed pierces, nāda rubbed, trident strikes; suṣumnā-emission beats the kalās till the bound one trembles. The left hand rises, the soul is joined to the Supreme — signs for the faithless, since unbelieving liberation needs seeing. Signs build trust, never cause release (Kulagahvara). The unseen is inferred through proofs; the Dīkṣottara adds the puryaṣṭaka-offering. On the ear-petal lotus Sadāśiva centers, four gods quartered from the east; senses, bodies, intellect, ego, mind go to Brahmā and the rest in order. Libation plus hundredfold fire: the renunciate initiation cleansing the eightfold city. City gone, no heavens — and no worldly rites after; Mādhavakula abandons piṇḍa, water, tears even for the dead. Śiva and wheel worshipped by capacity on the memorial days. Told: the Lord-spoken funerary sacrifice.
sections.FUNCTION: Establishes funerary initiation as proof-bearing release-technology: śaktipāta-gated, samaya-repairing, image-transferred, reverse-ordered, twofold-withdrawn; competence-gated and place-freed for the ripe; hell-rescue by compassion without pomp; forcible tattva-opening crowned by visible tremor; signs epistemically fenced as trust-builders, never causes; subtle-city offering replacing heavens; worldly mourning abolished for the established — closing in Lord-voiced seal.
sections.KEY TERMS: antyeṣṭidīkṣā (funerary initiation); antyasaṃskriyā (final sacrament); śaktipāta (descent gating the rite); samayopahatātman (samaya-struck self); pramāda (negligence needing repair); mṛtoddhāra (corpse-uplifting, image to corpse); ādi-anta-viparaya (last-first reversal); dvitayī saṃhṛti (twofold withdrawal); piṇḍapāta (body's fall); khecara (sky-rover); tattvasaṃpanna (ripe teacher, place-freed); śuddhacetas (pure-minded, rite-exempt); atikṛpālu guru (ultra-compassionate rescuer); śmaśānavidhi (cremation-ground rite, maṇḍala shed); pretasadman (mortuary, full-nyāsa school); saṃhārakrama (dissolution-sequence awakening); bindu-rodha, śaktibīja-vedha, nāda-ghaṭṭa, triśūla-tāḍa (four forcible openings); suṣumnā-visarga (inner emission beating kalās); kampate paśuḥ (trembling as sign); vāmahasta-utkṣepa (left-hand raising); para-yojana (joining to Supreme); kulagahvara-niyama (signs-don't-save rule); anumeya mokṣa (inferred liberation); puryaṣṭakārpaṇa (eightfold-city offering); śrutipatra-abja (ear-petal lotus diagram); sāṃnyāsikī dīkṣā (renunciate initiation); mādhavakula-niṣedha (no piṇḍa-water-tears rule).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 24 is the Tantraloka's funerary arc (a23 teacher-consecration, a25 ancestor-offerings, a26 post-initiation observances): the proof-bearing death rite answering a20's living proof (tulāśuddhi) with dying proof (tremor, raised hand). Cross-links: a18 (concise-rite kin); a19 (death-moment initiation kin); Mālinīvijaya (śakti-signs); Dīkṣottara, Siddhātantra, Kulagahvara, Tantrasadbhāva (cited canon); Mādhavakula (discipline); a21 (laukika-abolition kin).
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) secret sacrament announced; (2–4) scope — all stations, samaya-struck high ones, negligent stumblers with Dīkṣottara warrant; (5–6) image-to-corpse transfer, Siddhātantra reversal; (7–8) twofold withdrawal with sādhaka ease; freedom, sky-roving, place-freed teachers; (9–11) pure exempt, mantra-slain in hell, compassionate rescue without maṇḍala, strict full-nyāsa school; (12–14) dissolution awakening, four forcible openings, emission-beating with tremor-sign; (15–16) left hand, Supreme-joining, signs-for-faith with the Kulagahvara fence; (17–20) inference epistemology, puryaṣṭaka offering, lotus diagram, sense-offerings, libation plus hundredfold fire as renunciate cleansing; (21–23) no heavens, no worldly rites, Mādhavakula mourning-abolition, memorial Śiva-wheel worship; (24) Lord-voiced seal.
